headline: Jay Bharat Maruti Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Jay Bharat Maruti Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in the company. The full details of the acquirer, stake percentage and consideration are contained in the filed document.
detail: Jay Bharat Maruti Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates that any acquirer crossing 25% of voting capital (or subsequent increases of 2% for acquirers already holding >25%) must immediately disclose to the stock exchange and the company. The disclosure document was filed with NSE on or around 29 June 2026.
